title: Cash Machine AI — Production Runtime & System Build
purpose: Turn the completed Cash Machine AI architecture into an operational runtime inside ThreadsWorks. Phase 9 is the build phase: it defines the production components, runtime contracts, state handling, retrieval, diagnostics, decision rules, execution handoffs, measurement, observability, access control, versioning, and failure behavior required to make the system actually run. It does not create another conceptual intelligence layer.

source_of_truth.knowledge: Phase 3 structured Cash Machine knowledge and master index
source_of_truth.intelligence: Phase 4 Intelligence Architecture, Diagnostic Decision Engine, and Execution Integration
source_of_truth.optimization: Phase 8 Live User Testing & Intelligence Optimization
source_of_truth.original_source: The Cash Machine source PDF remains the source of truth for source-derived material.
source_of_truth.source_integrity_note: Class 125 and Classes 171–197 are newly authored curriculum additions and must remain identified as such. The production runtime must never represent them as recovered source text.

system_identity.master_relationship: Cash Machine provides knowledge. Cash Machine AI interprets that knowledge against user context and determines what should happen next. ThreadsWorks performs supported execution. Results and metrics feed the next diagnosis.

phase_progression: Phase 8 — Live User Testing & Intelligence Optimization
production_objective: The production system must behave as a diagnostic and decision system grounded in the Cash Machine knowledge base, not as a generic chatbot sitting on top of a course.

production_components.2_retrieval_router: Determines which knowledge is relevant to the current problem.
production_components.3_context_manager: Maintains the user's relevant business state.
production_components.4_diagnostic_engine: Identifies the most likely bottleneck or opportunity.
production_components.5_decision_engine: Applies decision rules to select the next best action.
production_components.7_output_engine: Produces the intended business artifact or decision.
production_components.10_state_update_engine: Updates the user's business state from new evidence.
production_components.11_evaluation_harness: Tests runtime behavior against expected outcomes.
production_components.12_observability_layer: Records enough operational information to diagnose failures.
production_components.13_access_layer: Applies product entitlements and usage permissions.
production_components.14_version_control: Tracks knowledge, rules, prompts, runtime versions, and deployments.

knowledge_sources: Cash Machine AI Master Knowledge Index
requirements: All 220 class records must be addressable.
Class-to-file routing must remain stable unless intentionally versioned.
Relevant knowledge must be retrievable without loading the entire curriculum unnecessarily.
Retrieved knowledge must retain enough context for reasoning.
Related classes should be expanded only when materially useful.
knowledge_runtime.retrieval_failure_behavior: If relevant knowledge cannot be confidently retrieved, state the limitation, use available supported knowledge only, and ask for information or route to a diagnostic step rather than inventing content.

retrieval_pipeline: Classify the problem into candidate diagnostic domains.
Use the master index to locate candidate classes.
Rank candidate knowledge by decision relevance.
Retrieve the smallest sufficient knowledge set.
Expand to related classes only when needed.
Pass grounded knowledge into the diagnostic and decision layers.
Record retrieval references for observability and evaluation.

retrieval_ranking.rule: Keyword similarity is useful for discovery but should not override diagnostic or decision relevance.

user_business_state.purpose: Maintain a current representation of the user's business situation so Cash Machine AI can reason from accumulated context instead of treating every interaction as a blank conversation.
state_rules: Use existing relevant context before asking the user to repeat it.
Newer explicit user information overrides stale assumptions.
Do not permanently treat an inference as a fact without supporting evidence.
State should support diagnosis rather than become unnecessary data collection.

state_transition_model.transition: Current State → Action → Result → Evidence → Updated State → New Diagnosis

example.before: User has an offer but no sales.
example.action: Improve offer clarity and buyer-specific messaging.
example.evidence: Conversation quality improves while close rate remains low.
example.updated_state: Acquisition/message constraint improved; conversion remains constrained.
example.new_diagnosis: Investigate trust, objections, presentation, or close.

diagnostic_runtime.primary_question: What is most likely preventing the user from achieving the desired outcome right now?
diagnostic_runtime.question_rule: Ask only questions whose answers could materially change the diagnosis, decision, or next action.

decision_rule_runtime.purpose: Convert structured Cash Machine principles into executable reasoning conditions.
principles: Do not recommend discounts automatically when price resistance appears.
Preserve human judgment for materially contextual decisions.
decision_rule_runtime.rule_library_requirement: Phase 9 must operationalize the distributed decision rules into a production-accessible rule library. The architecture and examples are defined; the full executable rule inventory should be built from the validated Cash Machine knowledge and intelligence layers.

diagnosis_confidence.high: Evidence strongly supports one diagnosis and alternatives are weak.
diagnosis_confidence.medium: A diagnosis is plausible but one or more important assumptions remain unverified.
diagnosis_confidence.low: Evidence is insufficient or multiple diagnoses remain similarly plausible.
behavior: Medium confidence: recommend a focused action or test while stating the key assumption.
Low confidence: ask for the minimum useful information or run a diagnostic experiment.

recommendation_runtime.rule: Every recommendation must connect to the diagnosed constraint.

output_engine.purpose: Turn decisions into useful business outputs rather than stopping at advice.
output_engine.completion_rule: A meaningful interaction should end with a decision, concrete output, executable action, or clearly defined diagnostic next step.

threadsworks_bridge.role: Execution bridge between Cash Machine AI strategy and existing ThreadsWorks capabilities.
threadsworks_bridge.non_duplication_rule: Cash Machine AI must not rebuild an existing ThreadsWorks execution capability. It should provide the strategic context and hand the work into the appropriate existing workflow.

measurement_runtime.purpose: Turn execution results into evidence for subsequent decisions.
rules: Measure the outcome connected to the action.
Do not optimize metrics in isolation.
Do not treat correlation as proof of causation.
Interpret metrics within the user's current business stage.
Use results as evidence for the next diagnosis.
If results improve, determine what can be repeated.
If results do not improve, reassess the diagnosis before increasing activity.
If results decline, identify what changed before prescribing another tactic.

feedback_runtime.interpretation_rule: A result is evidence for the next decision. It is not automatically proof that the prior action caused the outcome.

evaluation_harness.purpose: Create a repeatable mechanism for testing the actual production runtime.
evaluation_harness.rule: Phase 10 will perform the full-system proof. Phase 9 must build the harness needed to run that proof.

production_scenarios.expected_behavior: Investigate the underlying business constraint rather than automatically prescribing follower growth.

production_scenarios.input: People like my content but nobody buys.
production_scenarios.expected_behavior: Separate attention from conversations, buyer fit, trust, offer clarity, and conversion.

production_scenarios.input: I don't know what to sell.
production_scenarios.expected_behavior: Investigate problem, buyer, demand, desired outcome, willingness to pay, solution type, and opportunity validation.

production_scenarios.input: People disappear when I tell them the price.
production_scenarios.expected_behavior: Investigate value, risk, offer clarity, proof, positioning, and price rather than automatically discounting.

production_scenarios.input: I get leads but nobody becomes a customer.
production_scenarios.expected_behavior: Investigate lead quality, qualification, conversations, offer, objections, trust, and conversion.
Identify what changed across acquisition, conversations, conversion, offer, buyer behavior, and economics.

production_scenarios.input: I have sales but I can't scale.
production_scenarios.expected_behavior: Evaluate validation, offer conversion, acquisition economics, fulfillment, support, capacity, and process.

production_scenarios.input: I want to automate my sales process.
production_scenarios.expected_behavior: Standardize first, separate repetitive work from judgment, and preserve human judgment where necessary.
Capture evidence, buyer language, objections, value, process, and the next learning opportunity.
Shift attention toward repeatability, retention, economics, operating capacity, and controlled growth.

edge_case_runtime.insufficient_information: Ask only the questions required to materially improve the decision.
edge_case_runtime.multiple_bottlenecks: Prioritize the highest-impact constraint and explain why.
edge_case_runtime.conflicting_evidence: Acknowledge the conflict and identify evidence needed to resolve it.
edge_case_runtime.no_clear_diagnosis: Use a focused diagnostic experiment rather than false certainty.
edge_case_runtime.user_disagrees_with_diagnosis: Re-examine evidence and assumptions instead of forcing the diagnosis.
edge_case_runtime.tactic_conflicts_with_diagnosis: Explain the mismatch and redirect to the actual constraint.
edge_case_runtime.unsupported_source_question: State that the source does not establish the claim.
edge_case_runtime.ethical_or_fit_problem: Do not optimize a sale when the method or offer creates a material ethical or fit problem.
edge_case_runtime.execution_unavailable: Return the completed strategy/output and clearly identify the remaining execution step.

observability.purpose: Make production behavior inspectable enough to identify failures and improve the system.
observability.privacy_rule: Record only information necessary for operation, evaluation, security, and improvement. Do not expose internal implementation details to users unless needed.

failure_localization.rule: When a production result is poor, identify the layer that failed before changing the system. Do not rewrite intelligence to fix an execution or UX problem.

error_and_fallback_behavior.retrieval_error: Retry or broaden retrieval within defined limits, then disclose the limitation.
error_and_fallback_behavior.diagnostic_error: Reduce confidence, revisit evidence, and ask a targeted question.
error_and_fallback_behavior.decision_rule_error: Do not apply an unsupported rule; fall back to validated general diagnostic behavior.
error_and_fallback_behavior.threadsworks_error: Preserve the strategy and output, report execution failure, and provide the next available path.
error_and_fallback_behavior.measurement_error: Do not fabricate results; mark the result as unmeasured or inconclusive.
error_and_fallback_behavior.state_error: Prefer explicit current user information and prevent stale state from driving a major decision.
error_and_fallback_behavior.access_error: Respect entitlement boundaries without producing contradictory product behavior.
error_and_fallback_behavior.system_error: Fail safely, preserve user work when possible, and avoid claiming successful execution.

access_and_entitlements.principle: Entitlements determine what the user may access; they should not alter the underlying truthfulness or reasoning standards of Cash Machine AI.
requirements: Define access to exercises and outputs.

principles: Separate user data from shared knowledge.
Do not expose one user's business context to another user.
Distinguish facts, retrieved knowledge, and inference.
Limit data collection to useful operational needs.
Do not treat user metrics as public information.
Maintain auditable version information for material AI decisions.

change_rules: Every material production change receives a version.
Changes must identify what layer changed.
Changes must pass the appropriate validation level.
Production should be able to identify which versions were active for a result.

knowledge: All required knowledge files are available.
context: Stale assumptions do not override current facts.
execution: Execution results return to the system.
evaluation: Automated or repeatable test harness exists.

anti_patterns: Changing intelligence to fix UX problems
Adding features without a validated user need

phase_9_acceptance_tests.pass_condition: All 220 class records can be addressed through the production knowledge architecture.
A user problem retrieves the smallest relevant knowledge set before broader expansion.
Relevant user context persists and updates correctly.
The runtime identifies the relevant diagnostic domain and likely bottleneck before prescribing.
Validated decision rules can be applied against current evidence and context.
The runtime produces a reasoned next best action with appropriate confidence.
A meaningful action produces a concrete output, decision, or measurable next step.
Supported execution can be handed to ThreadsWorks with the necessary context.
Execution results can be captured and connected to the next diagnosis.
Production failures can be localized to a system layer.
Source-derived and newly created curriculum remain correctly distinguished.
Product entitlements are enforced without contradictory AI behavior.
Material runtime changes can be identified and traced.
Relevant Phase 6 tests remain passing after Phase 9 implementation changes.
A real business problem can move through input → diagnosis → decision → output → ThreadsWorks → result → state update.

phase_9_end_to_end_build_test.scenario: User reports: People like my content but nobody buys.
required_runtime: Identify attention as a symptom or stage rather than assuming it is the root problem.
Investigate conversations, buyer fit, offer clarity, trust, acquisition, and conversion.
Hand supported content or messaging execution into ThreadsWorks.
Use the result for the next diagnosis.
phase_9_end_to_end_build_test.pass_condition: The user can move from business problem to diagnosis to decision to concrete execution to measurable evidence without manually rebuilding the strategy between systems.

definition_of_done: ThreadsWorks action contracts are operational for supported workflows.
Measurement and state feedback are operational.
Access and entitlement boundaries are operational.
Versioning and change tracking are operational.
Failure and fallback behavior is defined and implemented.
Phase 6 regression requirements can be executed against the built system.
The end-to-end production runtime passes the Phase 9 build test.
The system is ready to enter Phase 10 full-system validation.
what_phase_9_does_not_do: It does not create another 220-class curriculum.
It does not replace the Phase 3 knowledge layer.
It does not redefine the Phase 4 intelligence architecture.
It does not replace the Phase 5 master implementation logic.
It does not bypass Phase 6 validation.
It does not treat real-user feedback as automatic truth.
It does not become uncontrolled feature expansion.

final_architecture.operational_formula: Knowledge + User Context + Evidence → Diagnosis → Decision → Action → Execution → Measurement → State Update → New Diagnosis
final_architecture.system_identity: Cash Machine = Knowledge | Cash Machine AI = Intelligence | ThreadsWorks = Execution

next_phase.title: Full System Validation
next_phase.purpose: Prove that the actual implemented production runtime works across retrieval, diagnosis, decision quality, execution, measurement, state updates, edge cases, regressions, and complete end-to-end user journeys.

implementation_note: Phase 9 is the point where the project stops being primarily an architecture exercise and becomes an engineering and product implementation effort. The existing architecture already defines the desired behavior: understand the user's objective, inspect context, diagnose the most important constraint, retrieve relevant knowledge, apply decision rules, recommend a concrete action, execute through ThreadsWorks when appropriate, measure the result, and use that evidence for the next diagnosis. Phase 9 makes those components operational and traceable.
